items.message: Regex extraction of workflow IDs and function names from source text is used to drive `getattr` and `inspect.getsource` calls. A workflow_id containing regex metacharacters (e.g. a `.` or `+`) could cause `re.search` in `_workflow_function` to match an unintended function name, and then `getattr(module, match.group(1))` would return an arbitrary attribute of the workflow module. `_workflow_ids` calls `inspect.getsource(module.register)` and then `re.findall` over that text to discover workflow ids. `inspect.getsource` reads from the installed package on disk. If an attacker can write to the installed package's source files (e.g. via a compromised dependency or writable site-packages), they could inject arbitrary strings matching `workflow(id="...")` into `register`'s source, causing `_workflow_ids` to return attacker-controlled ids.
